items.title: Is Delta Air Lines (DAL) Expensive After The FAA Ground Stop?
items.summary: A nationwide ground stop ordered by the FAA has put Delta Air Lines (DAL) in the spotlight, as halted flights, refund obligations and disrupted travel plans prompt investors to reassess the airline’s risk profile. Recent trading shows how quickly sentiment around Delta Air Lines can shift. The share price has slipped over the past week, yet a 30-day share price return of 14.44% and year-to-date share price gain of 24.89% point to momentum building over a longer stretch. items.title: Duffy Says an L3Harris Crew Was Working on the FAA Network When Flights Stopped. Its Stock Fell 4% After Hours
items.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said an L3Harris crew was switching FAA lines from copper wire to fiber when a router flooded the air traffic control network. L3Harris fell 4.2% after hours, and airlines owe stranded travelers nothing.
